+++ b/slugs.py
@@ -1,13 +1,36 @@
 """Make URL slugs for blog post titles."""
 import re
+import unicodedata
+
+# Latin letters that do not decompose into a base letter plus a combining accent.
+_EXTRA_LETTERS = {
+    "ß": "ss",
+    "ø": "o",
+    "æ": "ae",
+    "œ": "oe",
+    "đ": "d",
+    "ł": "l",
+    "ð": "d",
+    "þ": "th",
+    "ı": "i",
+}
+_EXTRA_TABLE = str.maketrans(_EXTRA_LETTERS)
+
+
+def _strip_accents(text):
+    """Turn accented Latin letters into plain letters; other scripts are left as they are."""
+    text = text.translate(_EXTRA_TABLE)
+    decomposed = unicodedata.normalize("NFD", text)
+    return "".join(ch for ch in decomposed if not unicodedata.combining(ch))
 
 
 def slugify(title, max_len=60):
     """Lower-case ASCII letters, digits and single hyphens only: "Hello, World!" -> "hello-world".
 
-    Accented letters are written without their accents ("Café" -> "cafe").
+    Accented Latin letters are written without their accents ("Café" -> "cafe",
+    "Straße" -> "strasse"). Characters from other scripts (Cyrillic, CJK, ...) are dropped.
     """
-    text = title.lower()
+    text = _strip_accents(title.lower())
     text = re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text).strip("-")
     return text[:max_len].rstrip("-")

 def test_post_url():
     assert post_url("Spring Menu", 2026) == "/blog/2026/spring-menu/"
+
+
+def test_accented_letters_become_plain_letters():
+    assert slugify("Café Olé") == "cafe-ole"
+    assert slugify("Über Küche") == "uber-kuche"
+    assert slugify("Año Nuevo") == "ano-nuevo"
+
+
+def test_non_decomposing_letters_are_mapped():
+    assert slugify("Straße") == "strasse"
+    assert slugify("Smørrebrød") == "smorrebrod"
+    assert slugify("Łódź") == "lodz"
+
+
+def test_non_latin_scripts_still_dropped():
+    assert slugify("Привет мир") == ""
+    assert slugify("Café 東京") == "cafe"
+
+
+def test_length_cap_with_accents():
+    assert slugify("café " * 30, max_len=12) == "cafe-cafe-ca"
